description: Accepted-risk suppressions for the security CI gate. Every field below is REQUIRED and enforced by utils/security/SecurityReporter.js: an entry missing code, target, expiresAt or approvedBy is discarded with a warning and the finding is NOT suppressed. Matching is per-code AND per-target (use "*" to accept a risk on every origin), and an entry past its expiresAt stops suppressing and becomes a BLOCKING finding so stale exceptions cannot hide a regression.

fields.code: Finding code to suppress, e.g. A05-TRACE.
fields.target: Exact origin the acceptance applies to, or "*" for all origins.
fields.reason: Why the risk is accepted. Shown verbatim in the HTML report.
fields.expiresAt: When the acceptance lapses (YYYY-MM-DD). After this date the finding blocks CI.

suppressions.reason: Next.js / GCP edge gateway returns HTTP 500 on the TRACE verb instead of 405. The request is rejected and the response does not reflect request headers, so there is no Cross-Site Tracing risk.
